status: full-time in-office, exempt/salarycompensation: base salary of $100,000 - $110,000 doeare you the right fit? would it excite you to have a pivotal role in communicating to our community what is necessary to overcome our housing shortage and make home more attainable to everyone? if yes, please keep reading. about useveryone deserves a place to call home. not just an address or somewhere to take shelter, but a little slice of the universe that’s all your own. a place where you can plant roots and grow. where you have a voice. where you make memories. where you always belong. a house is a structure with four walls and a roof—but a home is wherever you can be you. that place might look a little different to everyone, but the feeling of safety and comfort it provides is universal. and to us, that’s a feeling no one should live without.since 1909, the master builders association of king and snohomish counties has been making home happen. we live in one of the best places in the world, and as representatives of our region’s housing industry, it’s our duty to keep it that way—by making housing available and attainable to everyone. that’s why we support those who provide the puget sound region with places people can call home.we’ve been the voice for builders for more than 100 years, helping to shape our community for the greater good. we devote years to creating legislation that promotes a free market where housing supply can keep up with regional demands. we collaborate with our communities to develop land in ways that serve everyone, balancing environmental preservation with housing provision. and we’re continuously building a home of our own, where our members can connect, learn from each other, and succeed. together, we’re determined to provide our region with attainable housing—today, tomorrow, and for the next 100 years.there’s a reason people say home is where the heart is—because home is where everything begins. it’s integral to human success, to creating connected communities, and to building a better tomorrow. that’s why, as the master builders association of king and snohomish counties, we don’t just make housing happen—we make home happen.what it takes to succeedhere are the skills and traits you’ll need to be successful in our organization.a team player -- you define personal success by the success of the association and your teammates in addition to the excellence of your own work.courageous – you are always willing to try something new, whether that is a new responsibility or a new way of approaching an existing one.self-motivated but also collaborative – you take full ownership of your work statement but also enjoy working with a team.highly adaptive and resilient – when necessary, you are happy to iterate, react to changes in requirements, and learn for next time.organized and detail-oriented – you have a knack for record-keeping and multi-tasking and have strong proofreading and copyediting skills.an excellent communicator – you write and speak effectively at varying levels of technical detail depending on what is most effective with any given audience.skilled & experienced but also humble – you are confident in what you bring to the team while recognizing that your opinion isn’t the only one that matters.a good coach – if you are managing people, you are comfortable both praising excellence and identifying areas for improvement.position overviewthe advocacy communications manager has an overarching primary objective: to ensure members, policymakers, and broader community understand mbaks’ advocacy priorities and how to make home more attainable for all.to accomplish that objective, the advocacy communications manager has four primary responsibilities:1. develop and execute strategic, member-focused communications that advance the priorities of the homebuilding industry and demonstrate the value of mbaks advocacy.2. contribute to a culture of excellence within the team to advance the priorities and objectives of the association.3. provide coaching, feedback, challenging tasks, cross-training opportunities, mentoring, and soft-skills consultation to any direct reports. and as you collaborate with staff on projects, help them understand the “why” in addition to the “what” of your recommendations.4. develop and / or maintain processes, tools and behaviors that support the needs of the association’s stakeholders. focus on effective project management and timeliness and quality of deliverables while being approachable, flexible and professional.the advocacy communications manager currently oversees one other staff member and works closely with internal stakeholders to create and distribute a wide variety of impactful communication pieces in support of the association’s programs, products and experiences, primarily those relating to its advocacy efforts.the position communicates with a wide variety of audiences, including homebuilders and remodelers, industry professionals and suppliers, elected officials, and the general public, across websites, targeted emails, a weekly e-newsletter, social media, advertising, presentations, and digital and physical collateral for events.the advocacy communications manager needs to understand the unique voice and branding elements for each of those audiences and be adept at both overseeing and executing the full production process for all forms of communication. success in this role requires strong writing and storytelling, public policy fluency, visual communication skills, and the defining how uber comes to life through illustration, motion, design language, visual storytelling, and moments of delight across our products .this is a senior creative leadership role for someone who can establish a compelling creative vision and also get close to the work. you'll lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team while staying close to the work-developing and prototyping new creative concepts and systems, working directly alongside designers to explore and refine ideas, and providing a high bar for craft. you'll lead through both direction and making, helping push the work from good to exceptional.you'll work across design systems, product design, brand, marketing, engineering, and product to create an expressive language that is distinctly uber while building the systems a complex matrix organization. you should be equally comfortable setting a multi-year creative direction, presenting to senior leadership, leading a critique, and opening the tools to explore an idea yourself.what you will do define uber's product expression. establish and evolve a clear creative vision for how illustration, motion, visual storytelling, and moments of delight show up across uber's products.  set an exceptional bar for craft. develop a strong point of view on what great looks like and help teams consistently reach that bar without sacrificing speed or scalability.  be a hands-on creative leader. this is not a role that directs exclusively from the sidelines. explore concepts, prototype ideas, create visual and motion direction, and work alongside designers when the work benefits from your direct involvement.  lead and grow the expression team. inspire, coach, and develop designers across illustration, motion, and visual design while building a culture of experimentation, critique, and exceptional craft.  create systems, not just moments. turn strong creative ideas into reusable principles, patterns, tools, and systems that can scale across products, teams, markets, and use cases.  partner deeply with product design and design systems. work closely with product and systems teams to make expression an intentional part of the experience rather than a decorative layer added at the end.  navigate and influence a matrix organization. build strong relationships across product, brand, marketing, engineering, and design. create alignment across teams with different priorities while maintaining a coherent creative vision.  connect brand and product. help translate the uber brand into meaningful product experiences while recognizing that product expression has its own needs, constraints, and opportunities.  lead through influence. build excitement around a creative direction, communicate the rationale behind it, and bring senior leaders and cross-functional teams along without relying on organizational authority.  champion experimentation. encourage the team to explore broadly, prototype quickly, and pursue unexpected ideas before converging on solutions that can scale.  direct and participate in creative reviews. lead critiques, working sessions, and creative explorations that make the work stronger while helping teams understand the principles behind the feedback.  move fluidly between vision and detail. be comfortable shifting from long-term creative strategy to reviewing the timing of an animation, the composition of an illustration, or the details that make an interaction feel uniquely uber. basic qualifications 10+ years of experience in creative direction, product design, visual design, motion design, illustration, or related disciplines.  significant experience leading creative teams and setting creative direction for large-scale digital products, brands, or experiences.  a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft and creative leadership across multiple forms of expression, with particular strength in areas such as motion, illustration, visual design, or interactive experiences. expertise in one or more creative disciplines-particularly motion, illustration, visual design, or interactive storytelling-with strong judgment across the others.  experience building creative about junojuno leverages collective bargaining power to secure better student loan rates for students. with 290,000+ members and over $2b in negotiated loan volume, we've proven that group buying works. we are the most popular way to pay for the world's top graduate programs, and we're looking for someone to own the communications that reach our members at the moments that decide whether they borrow with us.the problemfederal lending reforms have created a significant market shift. in july 2026, new caps on federal graduate loans, including the elimination of grad plus for new students, came into effect, leaving millions of students with significant funding gaps. students need transparent, competitive private options, exactly what juno provides.your missionwe're seeking a marketing communications manager to own how juno talks to its members across all our products and business lines. most of that conversation happens over email and sms: juno sends at high volume to a member base of 290,000+, and the gap between a good send and a great one is measured in funded loans.you'll be the person who turns what we know about our members into the right message, to the right audience, at the right moment in their borrowing cycle, and who can prove what it did. this role is based in our miami office, and you'll train in person with our team during your first few months.what you’ll doown member communications end to end: write, build, qa, and ship email and sms campaigns and automated flows in customer.io across grad, undergrad, and refi.own the juno voice: write messages that are clear, accurate, and on-brand, and keep that voice consistent across every send.run the communications calendar: translate the goals of grad leaders and senior team members into a calendar of shipped sends, and keep it moving every week.learn the juno product and data model deeply:understand how a member moves from signup to rate offer to application to funded loanknow what we hold on every member, where it lives, and what it can and can't tell youuse that structure to build segmentation and personalization that hold up at scaleget the audience right: define who receives what by vertical, school, application stage, loan status, and timing. a mis-scoped audience is the most expensive mistake in this role.personalize at scale: use member data and liquid to tailor content, and help improve our personalization workflows over time.own measurement: report on what each campaign did. opens and clicks, but mostly applications started, applications completed, and loans funded. bring the read to the team before anyone asks for it.run the test roadmap: propose and run experiments on subject lines, messaging, timing, and sequencing, and keep a record so we stop re-learning the same lessons.keep the program clean and compliant: route messaging through compliance review, maintain suppression and deliverability hygiene, and keep the account organized enough that someone else could pick up your work.use ai as a multiplier: draft, edit, qa, and analyze with ai tools: copy variants, segment logic, liquid, and post-send analysis. we expect the work to move faster because of them, and we expect you to catch it when the output is wrong.what we offercompensation: base salary range of $80,000 to $100,000, depending on experience, plus an annual performance bonus.benefits: comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, plus 401(k) matching.what we’re looking forbackground: typically 1 to 4 years in marketing communications, email marketing, crm, pr, or content.hands-on experience with an email platform (customer.io, klaviyo, braze, hubspot, mailchimp) is a strong plus; we'll teach you our setup.open to a communications or pr professional who wants to own a high-volume channel, or an email marketer who wants to sharpen their writing and data skillsexcellent writing: you can write a short, clear email or text that gets someone to take one action, and you can adapt your tone for students, parents, and graduates.you value direct communication: you see email and sms as among the most powerful ways to reach people, and you want to get better at them.comfortable with data: you can read a campaign report, reason about an audience, and tell a real result from noise. you don't need sql on day one, but you should want to learn it.ai fluency: you already use ai in your daily work and can walk us through exactly how. we care less about which tools you use than whether you've actually changed the way you work, and whether you know where they fall down.precision: the work is high-volume and unforgiving of small errors, because a wrong merge field or a mis-scoped audience reaches thousands of people at once. you check your work, and you build processes so the checking isn't the only thing standing between us and a mistake.reliability: you do what you said you would, when you said you would. the team will trust you to run this program without hand-holding.execution over ideation: you'll ship a lot. you'd rather run the calendar well than spend the week debating it.curiosity about the product: you want to understand how student lending actually works (federal versus private, what drives a rate, cosigners, deferral, and refinancing), because you can't communicate clearly about a product you don't understand.comfort with seasonality: our year has a peak. you plan for it months ahead and go all-in when it lands.location: based in miami or willing to relocate, and authorized to work in the us.the x-factoryou're precise: you catch the broken link before it goes to 40,000 peopleyou're a sharp writer: you can say it in half the words and it lands betteryou close the loop: a campaign isn't done until you've reported what it didyou think in systems: you'd rather build the process once than do the thing by hand ten timeswhy join juno?the opportunityreal impact: help hundreds of thousands of students get access to the lowest rates on the market.market timing: federal aid changes create massive tailwind for growth.proven model: $2b+ negotiated and 290k+ members. product-market fit achieved.

detail.desc: job descriptionchicago or northbrook, illinois, united states (hybrid 3 days a week on-site)at ul solutions, you’ll have the opportunity to work for a safer world, using your corporate communications experience and expertise to elevate the external profile of a global leader in the testing, inspection, and certification industry.we are hiring a corporate communications lead, executive visibility & thought leadership, reporting to the director of executive and business communications. this role drives proactive external visibility for senior business leaders by translating complex technical topics related to global megatrends (energy transition/electrification, ai/digitalization and sustainability) into high-impact thought leadership, executive positioning and engagement opportunities.the corporate communications lead will also manage select internal communications for the business, providing strategic counsel and communications support for business- or enterprise-wide change-management and business-transformation programs.the ideal candidate is a seasoned and versatile communications professional and writer with experience in corporate media relations, executive communications and speechwriting, social media strategies, and internal corporate communications. a journalism background is a plus but not required. in-house corporate communications experience is essential.this position enables senior leaders to engage effectively with customers, industry, government, and academic audiences across key business verticals. this hybrid role requires working from the office three days per week.responsibilitieslead executive visibility programs for senior business leaders and technical experts, including media placements and speaking engagements aligned to priority verticals. develop message architecture and storylines that translate business priorities and technical content into clear, credible external narratives. develop executive briefings, talk tracks, interview preparation materials and other assets that ensure leaders are ready, confident and message‑aligned. collaborate closely with corporate communications’ agency partner to support external thought‑leadership opportunities tied to business priorities. partner with contributed‑content team to support development of bylined articles and trade‑media thought leadership. coordinate with external communications to ensure engagements, materials and messaging are consistent with outreach plans and approved guidance. use established decision-making and escalation guidelines to determine when activities can proceed and when additional leadership alignment is required. track and report on executive visibility activity and outcomes in support of monthly vertical updates. qualificationsproven experience supporting senior leaders (vp/svp/evp or equivalent) with executive communications, thought leadership or external visibility programs. ability to synthesize complex technical subject matter into concise, externally relevant messages for diverse audiences. excellent writing and editing skills across executive communications formats (e.g., speeches, talking points, briefing documents, social media posts, etc.). sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive topics. ability to operate independently in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. 7+ years of corporate communications experience. bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, business, or a related field. what you’ll experience working for ulsul solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. from day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. we break things, burn things and blow things up. all in the name of safety science.that’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. it takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. it takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.this is more than a job. it’s a calling. a passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. as a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.everyone here is unique. but we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. join ul solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. it means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. at ul solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.join ul solutions to be at the center of safety. to learn more about us and the work we do, visit  ul.comtotal rewards: we understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. the estimated salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. this position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary. this position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401k) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. we also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (15 days), holiday including floating holidays (12 days) and sick time off (72 hours).about usa global leader in applied safety science, ul solutions (nyse: uls) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. ul solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. the ul mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. we help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. our science is your advantage.

communication and reporting: develop conference reports and meeting recaps, ensuring clear communication internally and externally. lead internal cross-functional meetings and provide project management insights to clients as needed. financial reporting: oversee weekly and monthly client financial reporting, including billing summaries and financial analysis. provide regular updates to senior management as required. team development: manage the employee lifecycle for apms, including onboarding, training, development, and conducting performance reviews. address hr issues and escalate to senior management when necessary. what makes you a great fit education: minimum of a bachelor’s degree with emphasis in advertising/marketing and/or communications. experience: preferably 6+ years of agency or client-related pharma experience, demonstrating comprehensive understanding of advertising, marketing, media, creative, production, and research. project management skills: experience with key milestones in a product’s lifecycle (e.g., label changes, campaign launches). proficiency in managing jobs across multiple mediums, including digital and video. leadership: previous management experience preferred. strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience leading client meetings and building relationships. critical thinking: strong analytical and critical thinking skills to address complex project challenges. software proficiency: experience with project management tools (e.g., wmj, workfront, excel) and client-facing tools such as veeva. detail.desc: this role is a hybrid role with both in-person and virtual requirements. travel required to locations throughout the dallas-fort worth metroplex, with occasional travel to waco, temple and austin. travel is reimbursed.about us: join a dynamic, fast-paced team where your voice matters! we’re looking for a talented and motivated professional who is eager to make a big impact. if you thrive in a fast-moving environment, love solving problems, and have a passion for crafting compelling stories, we want you on our team!the role: as a senior media and public relations consultant, you’ll be the bridge between our organization and the news media. your role will involve pitching stories, building relationships with journalists, and helping to elevate our brand through earned and paid opportunities. we’re looking for someone who is ready to roll up their sleeves and dive into a variety of media projects that require strong writing, creativity, and adaptability.why you'll love working with usa collaborative team: work with talented, passionate people who are always looking to support one another.exciting opportunities: the chance to work on high-profile projects that make a real difference.a positive work environment: we believe in maintaining a positive, upbeat work culture where hard work is appreciated and celebrated.ready to join? if you’re excited about shaping the future of healthcare, solving challenges, and working in an energetic, creative environment, apply today! we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to the table.what you’ll dodevelop and pitch media stories that align with our brand’s mission and vision.cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key media contacts.write clear, concise, and engaging press materials, including press releases and media statements. respond to media inquiries and manage on-demand requests.problem-solve quickly and effectively when issues arise.monitor media coverage and create reports to track and measure success.collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistency in messaging and strategy.what we’re looking fora strong communicator with excellent writing skills and attention to detail.someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, on-demand environment.a creative thinker who can come up with innovative ways to tell our story.a problem solver with the ability to stay calm and efficient under pressure.a team player who is willing to work hard and bring their best to every project.a background in communications, public relations, or a related field.benefitsour benefits are designed to help you live well no matter where you are on your journey. for full details on coverage and eligibility, visit the baylor scott & white benefits hub to explore our offerings, which may include: immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5% tuition reimbursement pto accrual beginning day 1note: benefits may vary based on position type and/or levelqualifications education - bachelor's or 4 years of work experience above the minimum qualification experience - 5 years of relevant experience

communications, campaigns and events — including sensitive issues and major leadership announcements. you’ll own communication plans endtoend, create compelling content and use data to assess impact and continuously improve our approach.you will regularly translate complex topics into clear, concise messages and visuals that help employees understand what matters. you’ll write frequently using company and strengthen the employee experience.as a employee communications senior advisor, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future?responsibilitiesleads strategic execution of communications strategy and measures the effectiveness for the relevant team’s focus area.drives communications that inform and educate, and when needed, manage risk and mitigate crises.leads editorial development to establish a continuous and optimized presence across platforms (brainstorming, sheets, site copy and key messages/talking points.serves as a public information officer (pio) during incident management team activations, playing a vital role in supporting our customers and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity.minimum qualificationsten or more years of experience in corporate communications within a corporate and/or agency environment.preferred qualificationsbachelor’s degree or higher in public relations, journalism, communications, marketing or a related field. experience developing communication plans and content, including executive emails and talking points. experience writing following ap style and smart brevity principles. experience using email content platforms for employee communications, such as salesforce marketing cloud, microsoft amplify, etc. experience developing content and updating intranet sites using platforms such as sharepoint. experience planning and producing large employee events. experience developing communications to connect with field-based employees. experience using adobe creative cloud and canva. demonstrated understanding of content and communication trends and technology.strategic problem solver and highly creative in finding new ways to achieve team goals and elevate the employee experience. working knowledge of microsoft suite, including sharepoint, viva engage. experience communicating across different company levels, such as customers, colleagues and executives. additional informationthis position’s work mode is hybrid. the employee will report to an sce facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days.  unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of california.  further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. the work mode can be changed based on business needs.visit our candidate resource page to get meaningful information related to benefits, perks, resources, testing information, hiring process, and more!qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the los angeles county fair chance ordinance for employers and the california fair chance act. relocation does not apply to this position.position will require up to 20% traveling and being out in the field throughout the sce service territory.this position has been identified as a nerc/cip impacted position - prior to being hired, the successful candidate must pass a personnel risk assessment (pra) or background investigation. once hired, the candidate must complete specified training prior to gaining un-escorted access to assigned work location and performing necessary job duties.about southern california edisonthe people at sce don't just keep the lights on. our mission customers with the safety and reliability they demand. at sce, you’ll have a chance to grow personally and professionally, making a real impact in southern california and around the world.southern california edison is a proud equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.we are committed to ensuring that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. please contact us to request accommodations at (833) 343-0727.

4447710146.title: Senior OAR Science Communications Specialist (SME II)

detail.desc: overviewnoaa research is one of the most consequential science agencies in the federal government — advancing the forecasts that save lives, the data that informs climate policy, and the understanding of earth systems that shapes decisions for generations. but great science only creates impact when it is communicated well. as an oar science communications specialist, you will be embedded directly within a noaa oar laboratory or program, working alongside scientists and senior leaders to translate groundbreaking research into communications that inform, engage, and inspire. you are a skilled writer, a strategic thinker, and a natural connector — someone who can develop talking points for a congressional briefing, coordinate a nationwide all-hands meeting, and advise the oar communications director on sensitive engagement opportunities, all in the same week. this is a role for a communications professional who understands that the stakes of getting science communication right are high — and who brings both the craft and the judgment to do it well.fwi is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 top workplace by the washington post, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.work schedule and location: in-person presence required at one of the following locations: air resources laboratory (college park, md); pacific marine environment laboratory (seattle, wa); david skaggs research center (boulder, co); global fluid dynamics laboratory (plainsboro, nj); atlantic oceanographic and meteorological pci-p is seeking a talented, reliable, deadline-driven communication strategist to join our team supporting the exploration eva systems office at nasa’s johnson space center in houston, texas.the successful candidate will work with the team responsible for nasa’s space suits program to fulfill their communication objectives. the ideal candidate should demonstrate a strong history of professional feature writing, planning and executing communications campaigns, navigating a matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders and approval processes, designing and managing public affairs efforts, and collaborating with diverse groups. experience working with the media and preparing subject matter experts for interviews and public appearances is also desirable.responsibilitiesresearch, write, edit, and distribute news releases, media advisories, feature articles, web updates, blog posts, talking points, and other communications materials supporting nasa’s efforts to inform the media and public about the suits program’s activities and events.track the impact of these materials and present results and strategies to the program.ensuring accurate messaging aligned with agency priorities is required.identify and develop strategies, tactics, products, and messaging for the suits program, plan and conduct events, and evaluate their effectiveness.provide expertise and project management, ensuring ongoing communication with relevant agency stakeholders and external partners.will work as part of a small team, contributing individually and supporting team strategy, planning, and presentations.create and oversee the development of communications products and effortshandle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under stringent timelines and changing priorities/conditions.identify and develop strategies, tactics, products, and messaging for small and large activities.work collaboratively across the entire organization, other federal agencies, international partners, and private sector organizations to support nasa public affairs initiatives.write and develop feature articles, news releases, talking points, key messages, responses to questions, and communications plans.review and edit all materials related to hsmd portfolio for quality control and message alignment/accuracy before public distribution.act as liaison between programs, centers, and nasa directorates and the office of communications.plan and conduct media and public events.monitor news and public events to provide recommended courses of action on messaging and public affairs efforts.advise various management officials on possible public/media reactions involving proposed policy statements and agency actions.prepare nasa speakers for interviews, public appearances and events.travel to provide on-site communications support for activities.requirementsba/bs journalism, multimedia, communications, or related fieldat least 5 years of experience in strategic communicationsmust provide consultation and feedback to executive-level leadership teammust be able to write to a range of audiences and creatively explain complex technical ideas in an approachable, compelling way.must be highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to work in a dynamic environment.experience with editing and familiarity with ap style are a plus.flexibility to travel depending on mission and client requirements.nasa experience is preferred pci federal (pcif) and its subsidiaries are an equal-opportunity employer. pcif does not discriminate on the basis of age, sex, race, national origin, religion, marital status, sexual orientation or identity, veterans or disability status. preference may be extended to qualified native american indian candidates in accordance with applicable federal law.

about mind:mind robotics is building physical ai for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. we believe the hardest problems in ai are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.about the team and the role:we're looking for a senior communications leader to serve as our first dedicated comms hire and primary partner to our ceo. you will own both his public profile as it relates to mind robotics – earned media, podcast placements, press interviews, and executive voice – and the company's internal communications as we scale. you are a builder who can operate without a team, move fast, and do the work. this role will shape the narrative and public opinion for mind robotics’ next phase of growth.responsibilities:ceo & executive communicationsserve as the ceo's day-to-day communications partner: briefing docs, media prep, talking points, and message development for all public appearances.drive a proactive earned media strategy—pitch and secure placements on high-impact podcasts, business and tech press, and conference stages.own the ceo's editorial output: op-eds, public statements, and investor-facing communications.build and maintain relationships with journalists, podcast producers, and editors on the ceo's behalf.external & corporate communicationsdevelop and own the company's messaging architecture, narrative positioning, and crisis communications framework.lead all media relations: serve as primary press contact, manage inbound inquiries, and produce press materials for key milestones.support fundraising and product launch communications in partnership with leadership, finance, and legal.internal communicationsdesign and run the company's internal communications infrastructure: all-hands formats, leadership updates, and the cadences that keep a growing team aligned.write company-wide announcements, organizational change communications, and culture moments in a consistent, on-brand voice.partner with hr and people ops on employee experience communications as the team scales.requirements:externalceo media strategy: develop a 6-month earned media roadmap with target outlets, podcast targets, and placement calendar within first 30 days.press kit & messaging house: build a foundational messaging architecture and press kit (company backgrounder, ceo bio, boilerplate, faqs) within first 45 days.first placements: secure at least 2–3 meaningful ceo media placements (podcast appearances or press features) within the first 90 days.launch playbook: partner with rivian's communications team to co-develop artifacts, playbooks, and sops for initial operator deployments — establishing a repeatable framework for all future launch communications.internalall-hands framework: audit existing all-hands format and deliver a redesigned structure—agenda, narrative arc, ceo prep guide—within first 30 days.internal comms cadence: stand up a recurring internal newsletter or leadership update channel (slack, email, or equivalent) by day 60.new hire communications: develop onboarding communications materials that orient new employees to company mission, culture, and leadership voice.cultural moment coverage: own communications around at least one major internal milestone (hiring milestone, product update, company offsite) end-to-end within the first 6 months.qualifications:8–12+ years in communications, with significant in-house experience at a technology company; director-level or equivalent.proven track record managing executive communications for a founder-ceo or senior leader with an active public profile.strong media relationships across tech and business press; existing podcast producer and digital media contacts a strong plus.exceptional writer across all formats—press releases, executive narrative, internal memos, and editorial content.startup builder mentality: comfortable owning a function end-to-end, creating structure from ambiguity, and operating without a team.experience in deep tech, robotics, automotive, or adjacent industries preferred.

detail.desc: job title: group brand strategy directorreports to: presidentposition summarythe brand strategy team at pereira o’dell is tasked with creating and setting into motion the overall behavior of a brand. strategists must understand every element that impacts a brand’s behavior: culture, consumer, company, category - the entire landscape that affects the communications a brand puts out into the market to accomplish its goals.the group brand strategy director leads the brand strategy development for the brand, working closely alongside our other group brand strategy directors and reporting to the president. they are actively engaged in both existing business and new business, ultimately responsible for brand strategy framework and positioning development, target audience understanding, qual/quant research, and partnering with the research partner on ongoing brand health trackers. responsible for creative brief development and strategic recommendations.this role will be a hybrid role based in new york.duties & responsibilitiescultural anthropologist - reviewing and ensuring that the larger brand (strategic and creative) platforms the agency is selling in/working on are future-facing - we’re working with and learning from culture, and advancing it, not following it.trusted client advisor - build deep, daily working relationships with clients and become a trusted extension of their team. understand their business well enough to anticipate challenges, push their thinking, and provide a clear strategic point of view, not just when a brief lands, but throughout the life of the partnership.creative resource - guide the team down paths that best represent brand needs.business analysis - work to simplify the chaos. a brand challenge is multi-faceted, and yet the best creative solutions are singular in nature - your job is to marry these two realities.consumer behavior - in partnership with communications planning, find patterns in consumer behavior in an effort to reinforce or redirect how a brand is behaving in-market. this means finding new ways to connect, to position, or to operate based on audience information.new business instigator - partner with the new business team to create provocative and thoroughly analytical new business perspectives and thought pieces.mentorship - actively grow the abilities and skill of the department members through formal training programs, mentorship and hands-on learning. this also includes resourcing for the department in partnership with the director of resourcing.thought leadership - guide the agency and our clients in the development of communications, and the understanding of their own research. author perspectives on communications that have ramifications beyond our clients and our agency.overseer of tools - develop a recommendation and implement strategic planning tools to enhance the process through specific planning tools as well as syndicated or proprietary databases that enhance the level of thinking and insight injected into the entire process.required knowledge, skills, and abilities10+ years of experience in brand strategy at creatively driven agenciestrack record of motivating ground breaking and award winning ideasexperience managing and mentoring other strategistsexperience driving brand ideas inside non-broadcast, media neutral environmentsability to wear multiple hats in a dynamic, evolving agencysocial/digital channel understanding essentialdepth in analyticssalary & benefits:the base salary range for this role at the time of posting is $180,000 to $230,000. this position is eligible to receive a performance bonus. the eligibility of an employee to receive a performance bonus is based on numerous factors, including business revenue. the salary an employee or prospective employee is paid within this range will depend on factors such as but not limited to: internal compensation of current employees in similar roles, market considerations, budgetary considerations, level of responsibility, background, experience, and qualifications.full-time employees enjoy a competitive benefits package for you and your dependents to ensure a healthy lifestyle. our benefit offering includes: medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life & ad&d, 401(k) with company match, short-term and long-term disability, hsa, fsa, and maternity/parental leave.additional information:pereira o'dell is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the us federal e-verify program. at this time, we are not accepting resumes or candidates from third-party vendors.

alignment with brand priorities, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and business objectives.  identify content opportunities that support customer engagement, brand awareness, lead generation, and sales growth by partnering cross-functionally with creative, pr, product design, retail, trade, and sales teams to identify storytelling opportunities and bring them to life across digital channels.  develop content briefs and messaging frameworks for internal teams, agencies, freelancers, and external partners. campaign development & execution lead content planning and execution for integrated marketing campaigns from concept through launch.  partner with creative, merchandising, ecommerce, sales, and marketing teams to develop compelling campaign narratives and customer experiences.  coordinate content deliverables across channels to ensure consistency and effective message delivery.  support new product launches, seasonal initiatives, and strategic marketing programs through  exceptional project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.  ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment. preferred qualifications detail.desc: content strategist – modern office, great amenities including onsite gym + dog friendly!location: phoenix, az; onsite monday through thursday, wfh fridaysbase salary: $70,000-$75,000 benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401k, 3 weeks pto, paid holidays job type: full-time start date: asaptypical hours: m-f, 8:00 am – 5:00 pm (some flexibility) content strategist (content-focused marketing exp. req.; agency exp. not req.) description our client, a phoenix-based marketing agency, is expanding their team (~30 company-wide) and looking to add a content strategist to their office. this position is open following the promotion of their senior strategist to executive creative director. you will play a lead role in developing and executing content strategies across a variety of channels, helping shape the strategy, write copy, build creative briefs, and understand why certain messaging, formats, and approaches will resonate with a specific audience. whether you have agency experience or are looking for the opportunity to join a progressive agency that works across a variety of industries and client audiences, this is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work alongside a team that looks for ways to stay innovative and challenge the status quo. what matters most is strong writing, strategic thinking, adaptability, and the ability to connect content back to business results.and then there’s the culture. a lot of companies say they’re culture focused, but our client’s employee tenure and reputation really speak for themselves. they’re a team that genuinely enjoys working together, which is why this is primarily an in-office role. what’s especially cool is that they don’t believe in putting people in a box. if you’re interested in learning something new or exploring another area of the business, they’ll actually encourage you to do it. and if that isn’t reason enough, if you have a pup you don’t want to leave behind, their office is dog friendly, too.content strategist (content-focused marketing exp. req.; agency exp. not req.) responsibilities• own content strategy across social, email, web, seo, paid, and digital channels• write and edit copy while shifting voice and tone across brands and audiences• turn business goals and audience needs into actionable content plans• develop briefs that give creative teams clear direction on messaging and execution• shape social strategy around platform behavior, audience interests, and current trends• incorporate seo and aeo best practices into web and blog content• review work for strategic fit, brand voice, accuracy, and overall quality• use performance data and audience insights to identify opportunities for improvement• share strategic recommendations with clients and collaborate across internal teamcontent strategist (content-focused marketing exp. req.; agency exp. not req.) qualifications • bachelor’s degree required (open to major)• 3+ years of experience in content strategy, copywriting, seo, or a closely related discipline• exceptional writing and editing skills with a strong command of voice and tone• strong background in email marketing with experience in either organic social or paid media• knowledge of seo/aeo, audience behavior, and using data to improve content performance

detail.desc: about audubonthe national audubon society is a leading nonprofit conservation organization with 120 years of science-based, community-driven impact, dedicated to protecting birds and the places they need, today and tomorrow. birds are powerful indicators of our planet’s health, acting as sentinels that warn us of environmental change and inspire action. audubon works across the western hemisphere, driven by the understanding that what is good for birds is good for the planet. through a collaborative, nonpartisan approach across habitats, borders, and the political spectrum, audubon drives meaningful and lasting conservation outcomes. with over 1,000 staff and more than 2.6 million supporters, audubon is a dynamic and ever-growing force committed to ensuring a better planet for both birds and people for generations to come. learn more at www.audubon.org and on facebook and instagram @audubonsociety.position summarythe communications associate will contribute to audubon’s team in south carolina by supporting general communications and community building efforts, helping raise awareness of our mission, programs and places across the state while educating and activating key audiences in support of our conservation and policy priorities. working closely with the senior communications manager and other staff, the communications associate will oversee day-to-day communications activities, supporting earned media efforts as well as the creation and distribution of content across web, social media, email, and other owned and paid channels.this position is classified as hybrid, in accordance with audubon’s “where we work” policy. hybrid employees are expected to work in an audubon office every monday and tuesday and an additional two days each month of the employee’s choosing. candidates should be located within commuting distance (40 miles or less) of audubon's offices and centers in columbia, sc, charleston, sc, audubon silver bluff sanctuary in jackson, sc or audubon center and sanctuary at beidler forest in harleyville, sc.compensation$27.00 - $29.00 / houradditional job descriptionessential functions support senior communications manager in the development of annual communications work plans for audubon’s team in south carolina. serve as primary implementer of day-to-day communications, working with leadership team to broaden audubon’s visibility and reach.work with program staff to proactively gather stories of our conservation and policy work and lead the production of consistent, high-quality storytelling that amplifies these stories via newsletters, blogs, social media, and other channels and promotional materials.produce and/or manage video and photo coverage of programs when appropriate.assist in securing local earned media for initiatives for audubon's work/initiatives in sc. manage media lists and develop relationships with reporters.support policy and community building staff with outreach and advocacy campaigns, leveraging tools like everyaction and mobilize to engage and grow membership.support the coordination, execution and documentation of special and annual events, including outreach and media coverage.track metrics and analytics across our channels, including earned media, social media and website, and develop regular reports for staff highlighting trends.preparing materials for our community and campus chapter use to amplify our advocacy and conservation outcomes.support a culture of philanthropy, including public funding efforts.maintains and fosters culture of safety.other job-related duties as assigned.qualifications and experiencebachelor’s degree required in journalism, communications, marketing, political science, environmental studies or other relevant areas of focus.1-2 years of professional experience with public relations, brand management, writing, editing, campaign organizing, project management and/or advocacy preferred. an equivalent combination of education and experience may also be considered.strong communication and interpersonal skills a must; ability to work with multiple stakeholder groups across a decentralized organization is also necessary.excellent english language writing skills, spelling, and grammar with a knack for online communications and messaging required.proficiency with microsoft office applications and obvious ability to easily learn how to use tools to manage online communications tools.demonstrated personal and professional commitment to and experience in advancing inclusion and belonging.strong proficiency in a wide range of digital platforms and programs, including microsoft office, adobe indesign and photoshop, wordpress, facebook, twitter, instagram, youtube, everyaction, mobilize or similar email management system.photography, sound and video recording and editing capabilities are a plus; experience in the nonprofit sector on issues related to conservation; knowledge of south carolina and its people/geography/history/environment.must be willing to travel, as well as commit to some evening and weekend work as needed.must have reliable transportation and/or a valid driver’s license.commitment to audubon’s organizational values of care, collaboration, change, integrity, impact, and innovation.experience fostering inclusive and collaborative work environments is valued.national audubon society competencies: this role will also be accountable to apply and develop the following competencies.building relationships: establish and nurture meaningful connections and trust with others while fostering an environment of inclusivity and respect.problem solving: find effective solutions to challenges and support decision-making by drawing on critical thinking, creativity, and systematic approaches.accountability: be reliable and trustworthy in fulfilling commitments while recognizing inequities that may impact the ability of others to fulfill responsibilities effectively.supporting change: adapt to changes and modify behavior in response to new information or unexpected obstacles while considering the diverse needs of others.critical thinking: take an active approach to analyzing, evaluating, and interpreting information or situations objectively and logically to make informed decisions or judgments.eeo statementwe are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic outlined by federal, state, or local laws. we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process for all candidates.accessibility statementthe national audubon society endeavors to keep our careers site accessible to any and all users. if you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact accommodations@audubon.org. this contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

about our organization citizens for responsible energy solutions (cres) is a non-profit organization founded in 2013 to engage republican policymakers and the public about responsible, conservative solutions to address our nation’s energy, economic and environmental security while increasing america’s competitive edge. this work includes building out robust political and advocacy operations to support republican clean energy champions in the u.s. house and senate. in addition to working with members of congress and legislative staffs to discuss policy ideas, the cres team members also collaborate with industry representatives and subject matter experts in their mission to bring americans together to solve our most pressing issues. cres policy goals include: reducing global emissions and growing the u.s. economy. enacting policy that builds off historically successful approaches to affordable clean energy. affordably reducing domestic emissions in a manner that can be leveraged globally.  to further its mission, cres established cres forum in 2017 to educate the public and influence the national conversation around clean energy solutions that are actionable, market-friendly and responsible. cres forum provides expert information to key decision makers, so they are empowered to act in addition to support annual forums and events, such as national clean energy week, to demonstrate how clean energy policies strengthen the economy, enhance america’s vital national security interests and help to preserve our environment for future generations.  scope of work: the director of communications advances cres' strategic priorities, mission and vision by executing a comprehensive communications and media strategy and strengthening the organization’s public profile. this role ensures consistent and effective messaging to legislators, policymakers, the media and the public—reinforcing cres' reputation as a leader in climate and clean energy advocacy. the director also plays a pivotal role in crafting compelling content, monitoring the media landscape, refining messaging strategies and building key relationships with external and government stakeholders.  reporting to the vice president of communications and collaborating closely with the government affairs, external relations and policy teams, the director helps shape public discourse, engage diverse audiences and enhance cres’ positioning. a primary responsibility of this role is to support cres’ long-term strategic planning. these duties include—but are not limited to—identifying opportunities to insert cres as an expert voice and/or areas for engagement to expand cres’ reach and exposure.    the director should demonstrate a strong desire to grow into a managerial role by fostering collaboration, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of high-performing teams.  responsibilities: drafts a wide range of external communications materials including press releases, media advisories, talking points, op-eds and executive remarks, ensuring alignment with cres’s messaging priorities. supports cres staff and spokespeople for external speaking engagements by developing briefing materials and conducting prep sessions. monitors news coverage and social media to assess media sentiment, track relevant narratives and identify proactive and responsive opportunities to insert cres messaging. leads the development and delivery of recurring communications products, such as the cres newsletters, in coordination with internal staff and external consultants. builds and maintains relationships with congressional communications staff and monitors public statements from lawmakers and relevant stakeholders to inform cres communications efforts. leads cres’ capitol hill communicators program, including coordination with affiliated caucuses and foundations such as the conservative climate caucus and the western caucus foundation. organizes and manages c6wc (cool conservative communicators collaborating on climate change with cres) programming and events, ensuring alignment with cres communications goals. serves as a thought partner with the development of broader communications strategies in support of legislative priorities, events and issue campaigns, in partnership with the vice president and the other director of communications. provides strategic direction for the development of multimedia content and digital assets—including blogs, social media, and videos—while collaborating with internal team members and vendors to ensure brand consistency. assists with the drafting and editing of high-level organizational documents such as annual reports, polling decks, briefing memos and messaging frameworks as needed. supports the implementation of the communications workplan by contributing to goal tracking, reporting and performance measurement in coordination with the vice president and director of communications. collaborates with the external relations team to provide communications support for grant proposals, reporting and donor engagement. ensures adherence to cres brand and style guidelines across all external-facing communications. performs other duties as assigned. professional attributes: demonstrates strategic thinking and leadership: effectively leads communications efforts with a clear vision, guiding cross-departmental collaboration to achieve organizational goals. manages competing priorities: excels at juggling multiple tasks, meeting tight deadlines and maintaining focus in a fast-paced environment. politically savvy: possesses strong instincts and the ability to anticipate how others, including media and policymakers, will respond to cres' communications and initiatives. exceptional writing and editing skills: produces high-quality content quickly, with meticulous attention to detail and the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences. highly organized and detail-oriented: demonstrates excellent organizational skills, ensuring seamless execution of communications strategies and materials. collaborative and team-focused: works well across teams, driving consensus and supporting colleagues to maximize organizational impact. creative and adaptable problem-solver: develops innovative solutions to enhance messaging and media engagement strategies. aspires to develop managerial skills: demonstrates a strong desire to grow into a leadership role by fostering collaboration, guiding team efforts and mentoring colleagues to achieve high performance and shared success.  education, experience, and skills: required: 6+ years of communications, press, or media relations experience in a policy, political, or advocacy setting bachelor's degree in communications, political science, public relations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience. outstanding writing and communication skills experience writing press releases and op-eds existing relationships with beltway reporters, capitol hill communicators, etc. demonstrated experience engaging republican policymakers, conservative policy organizations, or center-right audiences, including building relationships with relevant offices, coalitions, and media, and advancing policy communications objectives with those audiences.  preferred: existing relationships with energy beat reporters knowledge of energy and/or environmental policy experience working in federal or state government experience working at a not-for-profit or similar organization to cres social media management  compensation and competitive benefits: the salary range for this position is $110,000 – 130,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications. this is a full-time, exempt position. cres is committed to pay equity and transparency and offers a competitive compensation and benefits package: excellent health, vision, dental and prescription drug insurance paid short- and long-term disability insurance flexible spending account generous paid time off (pto) retirement plan match transportation benefit cell phone reimbursement  equal opportunity employer statement: cres is an equal opportunity employer. cres’ policy applies to all terms, conditions and privileges of about onxwe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.we’re a high-growth tech company. the pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. as the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. each of our verticals - hunt, offroad, backcountry, and fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.we operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. we expect our people to use the latest tooling, including ai, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.about this opportunityonx is seeking an advocacy marketing manager who will bring our access & stewardship work to life through integrated marketing that builds awareness, strengthens brand trust, and inspires customers to engage with onx’s work to protect and expand outdoor recreational access.in this role, you’ll translate access & stewardship priorities into compelling campaigns, storytelling, and customer experiences across channels. you’ll own complex advocacy marketing initiatives from development through launch and measurement, bringing strong judgment, creativity, and a deep understanding of advocacy marketing to the work.as part of the brand programs team, you’ll work closely with the access & stewardship program team, brand creative, pr, vertical marketing, product, and other partners to connect this work to the broader onx brand.this role will report to the integrated brand campaign director, who owns broader brand campaign strategy, prioritization, and sequencing across parent brand and a&s marketing.what you'll doessential job duties & functionsadvocacy marketing & campaignspartner with brand and access & stewardship leadership to help shape the marketing approach for a&s priorities, then develop and lead integrated marketing plans across relevant channels, owning execution from development through launch, optimization, and measurement.translate complex program priorities and subject-matter inputs into clear, compelling customer-facing campaigns, messaging, briefs, and experiences.identify and test new approaches to advocacy storytelling, channel activation, and customer engagement, using insights and results to strengthen future work.extend and adapt access & stewardship stories across onx brand and vertical marketing efforts, balancing program needs with broader brand priorities.storytelling & brand stewardshipdevelop credible, engaging storytelling that helps customers understand and act on issues related to public land access and responsible recreation.steward the access & stewardship brand identity, messaging, and design guidelines, ensuring consistent expression within the broader onx brand while identifying opportunities to evolve the work.write, edit, and guide content across web, in-app, campaign, editorial, partner, and other customer-facing channels.partner with brand creative to develop high-quality assets and storytelling that are accurate, distinctive, and on-brand.cross-functional leadershipbuild strong partnerships across access & stewardship, brand, pr, vertical marketing, product, geospatial, and external partners to bring advocacy marketing initiatives to market.drive cross-functional coordination and proactively navigate dependencies, risks, and trade-offs to keep work moving and deliver strong outcomes.partner with access & stewardship and brand leadership to understand priorities, timing, and context and translate them effectively into marketing initiatives.bring clarity and recommendations to cross-functional partners, resolving routine alignment and execution issues while escalating broader strategic or program-level decisions when needed.measurement & reportingrecommend and track success measures for advocacy marketing initiatives, aligned with broader brand measurement priorities.monitor campaign performance and use insights, customer response, and partner feedback to improve future work.communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to partners and brand leadership, connecting marketing outcomes to access & stewardship program goals and broader business objectives.surface emerging risks, opportunities, and trade-offs early, using data and insights to inform recommendations.what you’ll bringfive (5) or more years of marketing experience, including developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns from concept through launch and measurement.demonstrated experience in cause-based or mission-driven marketing, with an understanding of how to engage audiences around complex issues and inspire action.strong storytelling, writing, and creative ideation skills, with the ability to develop compelling customer-facing content and partner effectively with creative teams.experience translating complex or nuanced subject matter into clear, credible, and engaging marketing, with strong judgment around accuracy, brand integrity, and stakeholder sensitivity.demonstrated ability to independently manage complex initiatives, balance multiple priorities, and move work forward in a cross-functional environment.strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience building alignment and influencing partners across different functions and areas of expertise.strong integrated marketing experience, including comfort developing marketing for social channels.experience using campaign performance, audience insights, and feedback to evaluate effectiveness and inform future marketing decisions.experience using ai tools in day-to-day work to improve productivity, creativity, and quality, with curiosity about how emerging capabilities can strengthen marketing work and sound judgment over outputs.bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.a strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including aia shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onx’s company values.permanent us work authorization is a condition of employment with onx.ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onx strategic location, such as a basecamp. added bonusesthough not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:experience with public lands policy, outdoor recreation, conservation, or related issues and audiences.experience working within or alongside nonprofit, government, advocacy, or other mission-driven organizations.familiarity with the outdoor industry and the communities onx servethe onx experienceonx is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. we come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.while we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. we operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. priorities matter. while they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. you’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. you’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.where you can workonx is a distributed company with employees across the u.s. we have physical offices in bozeman and missoula, mt, along with virtual workforce “basecamps” in austin, tx; denver, co; kalispell, mt; minneapolis, mn; portland, or; salt lake city, ut; and seattle, wa. basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.we have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. candidates who live elsewhere in the u.s. detail.desc: we are sōvyn, an award-winning pr and marketing agency on a fast-paced journey growing and leading healthcare communications. we provide marketing and pr services for top healthcare technology and life sciences companies around the world. our experts are renowned for moving minds and driving a better healthcare ecosystem for all.sōvyn is 100% remote. you can work from anywhere as long as you have dependable internet and are willing to keep central or east coast hours.we are looking for a proactive, results-driven media relations specialist to join our remote team.position overviewwe are seeking a media relations specialist with 2–4 years of pr/communications experience—or a "recovering journalist" looking to translate newsroom expertise into strategic communications. in this role, you will play a key part in crafting compelling stories, building relationships with top-tier healthcare and tech journalists, securing high-impact coverage for our clients, and keeping a pulse on the evolving media landscape.key responsibilitiesclient account support: collaborate with internal teams to deliver consistent media wins, support client strategy sessions. assist media pitching: build and execute targeted pitching strategies across digital, print, and broadcast outlets to secure earned media coverage and client interviews.media monitoring & analytics & reporting: our team loves sōvyninnovative and award-winning expertisediverse, energetic, positive cultureexcellent 401k, health, dental, and vision plansgenerous pto, including vacation, parental leave, and summer fridays100% remote workcollaborative, inclusive, engaging processadditional informationthis position reports to the vice president of communicationsheadquarters are located in stamford, ctsōvyn is a registered trade name for knb communications llc
